# MageLift

> Magento in your own AWS or GCP account, with ACC/Upsun-shaped YAML and CLI.

MageLift is an open-source CLI (Apache-2.0). It is not a hosting service. You keep the cloud account and the invoice.

- Site: https://magelift.dev/
- Docs: https://magelift.dev/docs/
- Repo: https://github.com/magelift/magelift

## Who it is for

Agency tech leads and SME Magento owners who want production Magento in their cloud without starting from a blank Terraform/Pulumi stack, and without renting a Magento PaaS.

## Certified targets

| Target | Status |
| --- | --- |
| AWS ECS Fargate | Certified |
| GCP GKE Autopilot | Certified |
| AWS EKS / OVH MKS / Scaleway Kapsule | Experimental (not production-supported) |

Only certified cells are production-supported. See the capability matrix in the docs.

## Optional

- Compare to ACC / Upsun: https://magelift.dev/docs/compare-paas/
- Leave PaaS in a weekend: https://magelift.dev/docs/weekend-migrate/
- Getting started: https://magelift.dev/docs/getting-started/
